facts.text: Pump is the high level interface to the New Era syringe pumps, also sold as Aladdin by World Precision Instruments and LA by Landgraf Laborsysteme
A pump is constructed from a Port of the pyserial connection: pump = Pump(port)
Port opens a pyserial serial port and BAUD_RATE_DEFAULT is 9_600
Port.__init__ opens serial.Serial(port=name, baudrate=baud_rate)
Pump.__init__ sets the safe mode timeout and reads the model number, firmware version and firmware upgrade from the pump on construction
syringe_diameter_mm is in millimetres and its values are SYRINGE_DIAMETER_MINIMUM_MM (0.1 mm) to SYRINGE_DIAMETER_MAXIMUM_MM (80.0 mm)
safe_mode_timeout_s is in seconds within SAFE_MODE_TIMEOUT_DISABLED (0 s) and SAFE_MODE_TIMEOUT_LIMIT_S (255 s)
A safe mode timeout of zero sets the communication to basic mode and a non-zero value sets it to safe mode
PumpingDirection has the members INFUSE and WITHDRAW; pumping_direction is set as one of them and a value the direction tables do not know raises ValueError
The pumping volume setter refuses a value below 0.001/1000.0 mL and a value at or above 10_000.0 mL
The pumping rate limits are dictated by the syringe diameter of the pump
The pumping rate setter refuses a value below 0.001/60_000.0 mL/min and a value at or above 10_000.0 mL/min
pumping_volume_ml and pumping_rate_ml_per_min are read from a value and a unit the pump reports and converted to millilitres and millilitres per minute (VOL with ML/UL, RAT with MM/MH/UM/UH)
volume_infused_ml and volume_withdrawn_ml read the dispensation counters of the pump, the DIS reply "I" <infused> "W" <withdrawn> <units>
run(wait_while_running=True) sends RUN and waits while the pump is running; run(False) returns after starting it and wait_while_running polls the status every PUMPING_POLL_DELAY_S
run_purge sends PUR: the pump runs at maximum rate in the configured direction until it is stopped
stop(wait_while_running=True) sends STP and waits while the pump is running
The status property reads the Status of the pump and running is true while the status is INFUSING, WITHDRAWING or PURGING
Status has the members INFUSING, WITHDRAWING, PURGING, STOPPED, PAUSED, SLEEPING and WAITING
The command names are an empty name for the status and SAF, VER, DIA, DIR, VOL, RAT, DIS, CLD, RUN, PUR and STP
A request is the address, the command name and the formatted arguments, str(address) + name.value + arguments
In safe mode a request is framed as STX, a length byte, the request bytes, the CCITT CRC (binascii.crc_hqx) and ETX; in basic mode it is the request text with a carriage return
A reply is an STX ... ETX frame in basic mode and carries a length byte and a checksum in safe mode
The reply begins with a two character address that must equal the pump's address
The pump address defaults to ADDRESS_DEFAULT 0 and may not exceed ADDRESS_LIMIT 99
The README prints model_number (1000 for NE-1000) and firmware_version ((3, 928) for 3.928)

operator_required.name: pumping_volume_ml
operator_required.reason: the volume a pump can move is set by the syringe fitted: the class setter only states a protocol envelope of 0.001/1000.0 mL to 10_000.0 mL with an open upper edge (nesp_lib/pump.py:226-227), not a bound of the device; the site states the volumes its syringe allows

operator_required.name: pumping_rate_ml_per_min
operator_required.reason: the pumping rate limits are dictated by the syringe diameter fitted (nesp_lib/pump.py:255) and the class setter only states a protocol envelope of 0.001/60_000.0 mL/min to 10_000.0 mL/min (nesp_lib/pump.py:262-263); the site states the rates its syringe allows

safe_state.description: pump stopped (STP, Pump.stop without waiting): no pumping continues until a new run
